extName.description: Product name shown in the browser and the Chrome Web Store. "Mega Tabs" stays in Latin letters; translate only the words after the colon. At most 75 characters in total.

extDescription.message: Switch tab sets by project without reloading. Notes and a canvas sit beside them, and your AI can edit both. Private and free.
extDescription.description: Short summary shown in the Chrome Web Store and at chrome://extensions. At most 132 characters.

cmdTogglePanel.message: Open or close the mega tabs panel

muteStashTitle.message: Tabs in workspaces that are not shown play no sound

popupHint.message: ↑ / ↓ and Enter or Alt+Shift+↑ / ↓ switch · Right-click on a page: move tab

backupFailingHint.message: If a window is lost, all changes since then are missing.

storageFullHint.message: Once it is full, it can no longer switch workspaces or reliably save tabs. Close tabs or windows you do not need.

storageFullUpdate.message: From Chrome 112 on, the storage is ten times larger.

storageTight.message: This browser gives the extension only $1 MB of storage

storageTightHint.message: With very many tabs it can fill up, and then it can no longer switch workspaces or reliably save tabs. From Chrome 112 on it is 10 MB, and this notice goes away.

discardTitle.message: Remove the missing tabs from the backup

emojiLabel.message: Emoji, empty for the first letter

deleteLastTitle.message: The last workspace cannot be deleted

undoTitle.message: Brings back what was deleted, tabs included, until the browser restarts

undoFailed.message: Could not restore the deleted workspaces.

forgetDeleted.message: Hide; afterwards the deletion can no longer be undone

openTransferFailed.message: Could not open export and import.

exportText.message: Saves all workspaces with name, color, emoji, order, tabs and tab groups, the pinned tabs and the settings as a JSON file. Window IDs and the device key are left out.

exportPlainText.message: The file contains the full addresses and titles of all tabs in plain text, including any access tokens or sharing and password reset links in them. Passing it on or syncing the Downloads folder passes those on too.

importText.message: The file is checked completely first. Nothing changes until you confirm below.

mergeText.message: existing workspaces and tabs stay, nothing is closed.

replaceText.message: the existing workspaces are deleted and replaced by the ones from the file.

mergeNothing.message: “$1” ($2): all $3 already there, nothing to do.

replaceKeep.message: Keeps $1 in windows that match workspaces in the file open, with their history.

replacePinned.message: Pinned tabs stay open, missing ones from the file are added.

replaceUndo.message: Until the browser restarts, you can undo this in the popup.

fileRejected.message: This file cannot be imported. Nothing was changed.

settingsSame.message: The settings in the file already apply here.

importDoneFailed.message: Import complete: $1. $2 could not be opened, the popup lists them as “not restored”.

stashText.message: This hidden window belongs to the Mega Tabs extension. It holds the tabs of a workspace that is not shown right now. Please do not close it – use the panel to switch.

iconTitleStorageFull.message: Extension storage almost full, tabs will soon no longer be saved

importReplaceUnconfirmed.message: Replacing closes tabs and has to be confirmed.

exNotJson.message: The file is not valid JSON.

exNotList.message: “$1” is missing or not a list.

exOwnPage.message: Pages of the extension itself do not belong in the file.

exNotExport.message: This is not an export file of Helium Workspaces.

exBadVersion.message: The version number of the format is missing or invalid.

exNewerVersion.message: The file has format version $1, this extension only knows version $2.

exTooManyWorkspaces.message: The file contains too many workspaces.

exTooManyTabs.message: The file contains too many tabs.

exBadColor.message: “$1” is not a color of the form #rrggbb.

exBadId.message: “id” may only contain letters and digits.

exDupId.message: The ID “$1” occurs more than once.

exDupGroupId.message: The group ID “$1” occurs more than once.

autoText.message: Regularly saves an export to Downloads/$1/ and keeps the last $2. This way the workspaces survive even if the extension is removed or the profile breaks.

autoPlainText.message: The backups also contain all addresses and titles in plain text, including access tokens and password reset links. Syncing the Downloads folder passes those on too.

autoPending.message: Started on $1, the file is not saved yet.

autoFailedHint.message: Details under Export / Import. The next backup will try again.

autoBackupInvalid.message: Unknown interval for the automatic backup.

autoHint.message: Automatic backup is off. If the extension is removed or the profile breaks, all workspaces are gone.

autoHintSetupTitle.message: Opens Export / Import, where automatic backup can be turned on

earlierText.message: Or choose an earlier state. On every browser start the extension keeps the state from before, the last three remain.

earlierRejected.message: This state cannot be restored. Nothing was changed.
